minih264e.h from https://github.com/lieff/minih264 (master, last commit 2020-12-10), CC0-1.0.
Local change: the Apple arm64 branch near line 5600 called vtbl2q_u8, which is not an ARM
intrinsic and does not compile with current Xcode; it is vqtbl2_u8 (uint8x16x2_t table,
uint8x8_t index, uint8x8_t result), which is what that code means.
Local change: the __APPLE__ byte-order block used BYTE_ORDER/BIG_ENDIAN, which are undefined
there (both 0), so SWAP32 was a no-op and every 32-bit word of the bitstream came out reversed;
it now uses clang's __BYTE_ORDER__/__ORDER_BIG_ENDIAN__.
SoftH264.c/.h and module.modulemap are Smart Auto's.
